## Summary

- What changed?
- What observable result does it enable?

## Scientific boundary

- Which process owns the physics and hidden parameters?
- Which measured evidence supports each updated parameter?
- Are any capabilities intentionally unavailable or fail-closed?

## Verification

- [ ] Python lint and portable tests
- [ ] Frontend lint, typecheck, tests, and build
- [ ] GPU/Newton tests when physics changed
- [ ] Replay/re-execution checks when event or controller contracts changed
- [ ] Documentation and evidence updated without committing generated run directories
